property_summary: For any caller who makes a Collect call while their Acc balance is at least MinSum and their unlockTime has elapsed, the reference contract always reduces their balance by the requested amount when the outgoing ETH transfer succeeds; the mutant instead reverts the entire transaction when the recipient rejects the transfer, so the post-call Acc balance differs for fuzzed amounts and recipients that cause the low-level call to fail.
change_summary: Made the external call revert on failure by requiring the call success flag to be true.
